pr.title: Rework: close the lookup-table false accept and the zero-start-reset findings
Rework: publish the normative partition_application rule for nested modular schedules
Rework: repair unbounded recurrence expansion and grade count-omitted rules

Rework: make the plan order total and grade conflicts against provided names
